key_result: In human evaluation at 25 tokens, strict completeness was 10% for base BioMistral, 16% fine-tuned and 33% for the best pRAGe configuration, while hallucination was 4% for base BioMistral versus 8% with pRAGe.
notes: French medical paraphrasing. Local not explicit (open quantized models on a research cluster). Abstention only via 'say you don't know' prompt; no rate. Code on GitHub (ATILF-UMR7118/pRAGe). Inconsistencies: text says completeness-strict agreement 98% but Table 5 shows 84%/70%; text readability agreement 78%-68% but Table 5 shows 2%; '60-20-20' split vs actual ~63/17/20; word vs token length units. Retrieval did not clearly improve over the plain SLM on hallucination.
